question: In the RSC Advances study of biochar loading in dual-phase MIL-100(Al)/MIL-110(Al) hybrids for CO2 adsorption, why did the Langmuir model describe BC-20's CO2 isotherm better than the Freundlich model?
rendered: The Langmuir model did not describe BC-20's CO2 isotherm better than the Freundlich model. According to the document, the Freundlich model provided higher R^2 and lower RMSE, SSE and AICc values than the Langmuir model for BC-20.
